name: What permits are required for knee clearance sink installation in San Mateo County?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for knee clearance sink installation in San Mateo County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for knee clearance sink installation in San Mateo County can vary depending on the extent of the work. If the project involves significant plumbing alterations, structural changes, or modifications to load-bearing elements, a plumbing permit and potentially a building permit may be necessary. Minor cosmetic changes or simple replacements that don't alter the existing plumbing configuration substantially might not require permits. It's always best to consult with your local city's building department (e.g., San Mateo, Redwood City) or a qualified contractor like City Dweller, LLC, to confirm specific permit needs before starting any work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits in San Mateo County depend on the work's scope. Significant plumbing or structural changes typically require plumbing and/or building permits. Always consult your local city's building department or a contractor for specific requirements.
